verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community recollection of a natural-text event-creation feature (typing 'Dinner tomorrow at 7:30pm…' to create an event), described as an early feature that 'seemed to be returning'. That covers only event creation and is not confirmed by first-party documentation. The REST API items are developer building blocks and earn no credit for natural-language operation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of natural-language commands, coverage beyond event creation (editing, querying, scheduling, sharing), confirmation that the feature currently ships, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: typing natural text like 'Dinner tomorrow at 7:30pm at Foobar restaurant' to create an event automatically
